evidence.document: Issuer USDY holdings and Daily Attestation Reports locator

decisions.rationale: Primary exchange-hosted September 22 OGM BVI report, page 1, records USDY market-value liabilities of $198,949,893.44 within $1,437,389,833.73 total liabilities and a $1,532,537,048.33 shared asset pool; it supplies no USDY-specific allocation. The issuer USDY page provides the Daily Attestation Reports locator. Ondo USDY LLC_ATCAttest_260924.pdf, page 1, dated September 24, records $2,082,911,466.72 permitted assets and $2,066,700,997.67 token principal outstanding (coverage 1.007844). Page 2, footnote 1, explicitly excludes USDY issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited. These recorded figures preserve the scope finding if the archive locator changes. No new LLC numerator is mixed with historical consolidated supply.
sentinels: New LLC report does not resolve BVI claim allocation or same-close consolidated liabilities.
decisions.nextReviewTrigger: Issuer response with USDY-specific BVI pool allocation and same-close consolidated reconciliation.
